parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The ingest domain or streamer streaming domain.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- **stream_name_desc**: sorts by live stream name in descending order.
- **stream_name_asc**: sorts by live stream name in ascending order.
- **publish_time_desc**: sorts by stream ingest time in descending order.
- **publish_time_asc** (default): sorts by stream ingest time in ascending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: **1 to 3000**. Default value: **2000**.

parameters.name: QueryType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:
- **fuzzy** (default): fuzzy match.
- **strict**: exact match.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of stream ingest. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name. You can view StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: StreamType
parameters.description:
The stream type. Valid values:

- **Not specified**: queries raw streams.
- **all**: queries all streams.
- **trans**: queries transcoded streams.
